title: oily dutch flax bake
description: pungent, crisp, weeknight dutch dish featuring flax eggs and pickle. flexitarian-friendly option.
instructions: preheat oven to 375f. grease a 9x13 inch baking dish with butter.
in a large bowl, combine flaxseed, pickle, caraway seeds, onion, and garlic. mix well.
in a separate bowl, whisk together flour and salt. add melted butter and mix until crumbly.
add the dry ingredients to the flaxseed mixture and stir until just combined.
pour in warm water and mix until a sticky dough forms.
transfer the dough to the prepared baking dish and smooth the top.
bake for 35 minutes or until the top is golden brown and the edges are crispy.
remove from oven and let cool for 10 minutes before slicing.
Note: this recipe is for refrigerator pickling/preserving only — store in the refrigerator and consume within 1 week. Do not water-bath can without an acid (vinegar or lemon juice).
